title: Free literals of a term have pairwise distinct variables
statement: Let $t$ be a term on $n$ variables (a list of literals) and let $\rho$ be a restriction on those variables. Suppose that $t$ contains no repeated literal, and that any two literals of $t$ sharing the same underlying variable are in fact equal. Form the list of literals of $t$ whose variable is free under $\rho$, each kept together with its position in $t$. Then this list has pairwise distinct variables: any two of its entries carry different variables.
hypotheses_covered: t is a term (a list of literals) on n variables
ρ₀ is a restriction on the n variables
any two literals of t with the same variable are equal
conclusion: the free-variable filter of t paired with positions has pairwise distinct variables
replaced:
If $t$ has no duplicate literals and any two literals of $t$ with the same
variable are equal, then the free-variable filter of $t.\mathrm{zipIdx}$ has
pairwise distinct variables.
